title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
description: An American animated children’s television series inspired by A. A. Milne’s Winnie-the-Pooh stories.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x1
episodes_data.description: The pilot episode. As a reward for Christopher Robin eating all his vegetables, he along with Pooh, Piglet, and Tigger go to the theater to watch Birdzilla, a scary monster movie. During the film, Piglet gets scared and thinks the movie is real and the monster will get him. The gang tries to convince him that it is only make-believe and proceed to make their own monster film to prove it.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x2
episodes_data.description: Pooh has been borrowing too much honey from Rabbit lately. This makes Rabbit mad to the point where he says that Pooh is "eating him out of house and honey". Desperate, Pooh and his friends try to retrieve honey from a beehive, so Rabbit will not have to move away. Nevertheless, this proves to be a daunting task.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x3
episodes_data.description: Piglet, feeling sorry for Eeyore, who always seems to be depressed, convinces the others to spend a whole day trying to cheer him up.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x4
episodes_data.description: When the gang goes camping, Piglet is frightened by Tigger's stories and comes up against one of his greatest fears: Heffalumps.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x5
episodes_data.description: Pooh borrows a balloon from Christopher Robin and the gang all panics when Rabbit causes it to become deflated.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x6
episodes_data.description: Rabbit rescues a little bird named Kessie and finds himself in the role of parent. His overly-protective tendencies cause trouble when Kessie begins to feel an urge to fly, which Rabbit expressly forbids for fear of losing her.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x7
episodes_data.description: Piglet sets out with Tigger and Rabbit to the Land of Milk and Honey, hoping to get some honey for Pooh as a gift after Piglet gets an unexpected gift from Pooh. They discover a tiny race of Piglet lookalikes called "Piglies" who elect Piglet their king, which causes him internal conflict--especially when Tigger and Rabbit abuse the Piglies' hospitality.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x8
episodes_data.description: Tigger encourages Christopher Robin to clean his messy room by throwing everything he owns under the bed. This proves troublesome when the gang discovers that the evil Crud (voiced by Jim Cummings) and his sneezing minion, Smudge (also voiced by Cummings) occupy a land beneath the mattress and plan to spread messiness everywhere.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x9
episodes_data.description: All the honey in the Hundred-Acre Wood has disappeared and it appears to be the work of a Heffalump and a Woozle named Heff (voiced by Chuck McCann) and Stan (voiced by Ken Sansom). When the gang successfully recovers the honey, Stan decides to get backup in the form of a giant Woozle named Wooster--but Pooh's offer of friendship provides a surprising resolution to the conflict.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x10
episodes_data.description: When Rabbit forces Tigger to have a bath, the bounce-happy tiger's stripes come off. The gang believes that this "new" creature isn't Tigger, as all Tiggers have stripes, prompting an identity crisis in the sad tiger. Eventually, Eeyore solves the problem by pointing out that it is Tigger's heart, not his stripes, that make him who he truly is.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x11
episodes_data.description: The gang meets a wind-up monkey toy named Bruno, who claims to be the "best toy a kid could get," in Christopher Robin's closet. Bruno boasts that he is better than all of Christopher's old toys, making them fear that they will be replaced.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x12
episodes_data.description: Christopher Robin and the gang get into mischief while a babysitter tries to look after them.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x13
episodes_data.description: After a calendar mishap leads Rabbit to believe that his birthday has been forgotten, he decides to run away from the Hundred-Acre-Wood, only to found by a secondhand shop owner who puts him up for sale. While the gang tries to find Rabbit, the bunny himself must fend off some thuggish toys who are out to make trouble.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x14
episodes_data.description: After being buffeted about by the wind, Piglet becomes afraid of going outside.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x15
episodes_data.description: Pooh believes he can no longer enjoy honey when he loses his "sweet tooth," which has been stolen by pack rats.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x16
episodes_data.description: Pooh and the gang pretend to be in the Wild West during a play.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x17
episodes_data.description: When Rabbit throws away a lone bunny-shaped bookend, it finds its way all around the gang.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x18
episodes_data.description: Pooh and Piglet help a young heffalump who is having difficulty learning trapping from his father.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x19
episodes_data.description: Tigger takes on the identity of "The Masked Offender" in order to help people, but causes more trouble than he fixes.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x20
episodes_data.description: The gang is in a state of panic because they think they are being haunted by a ghost which was just Piglet running scared silly.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x21
episodes_data.description: When Tigger breaks a mirror Rabbit was using, Rabbit believes he has bad luck, and so do the others, but it turns out Tigger has the bad luck.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x22
episodes_data.description:
Christopher Robin gives Piglet "magic earmuffs" to help give him confidence in his ice skating. After losing the earmuffs, Piglet has a crisis of belief, only to discover his own skill when he must save the gang from the perils of an icy river.

The episode was a bonus on the video release of "Winnie the Pooh and Christmas Too".

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x23
episodes_data.description: When Christopher Robin shows Pooh a wishing star, Pooh tells Piglet, Tigger and Rabbit about it, and they all wish for something. But, when Pooh thinks he wished out the wishing star, and that the others' wishes will not come true, he tries his best to fulfill them all.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x24
episodes_data.description: Tigger thinks his great uncle is a lion and declares himself, "King of the Beasties" with chaotic results. (Note: This episode marks the first time Jim Cummings voiced Tigger)

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x25
episodes_data.description: Pooh and the gang try to deal with the pack rats during a flood.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x26
episodes_data.description: Piglet saves Tigger's life, and Tigger becomes Piglet's servant.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x27
episodes_data.description: When the gang finds a pile of feathers on the trail, they believe that they belonged to Owl and that he has gone bald.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x28
episodes_data.description: Piglet thinks he is too small and moves away from the Hundred Acre Wood.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x29
episodes_data.description: Rabbit is at his wit's end when Gopher is forced to move in with him.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x30
episodes_data.description: Rabbit gives Tigger weighted shoes and challenges him to jump the highest rock in the wood to keep him out of the way.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x31
episodes_data.description: When Rabbit takes Gopher's flashlight without asking, Gopher panics and he and the rest of the gang go in search of it.

episodes_data.title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh 1x32
episodes_data.description: Eeyore dresses up like Tigger in order to become more popular.
